svg.title: Timeline of the Fireworks AI incidents and the Uber driver notices, 6 October to 16 November 2026
svg.text: Six weeks from stolen keys to stolen licences
What Fireworks AI, Uber and Notion disclosed, and when (2026). Red marks a point where the known damage grew.
6 Oct
Fireworks spots stolen internal credentials in use
Secrets stored in customers' evaluation jobs, such as API keys and tokens, are read
7 Oct
Uber data reached with a vendor's valid credentials
Driver's licence images and text pulled from a cloud storage area; no alert fires
9 Oct
Fireworks tells Uber and posts its first bulletin
"No evidence" then of access to customer models, datasets or personal information
Second intrusion through a cloud host for R&D machines
Attacker runs a workload on Fireworks development machines; caught the same day
9 Nov
Bulletin update widens the damage
Billing details for accounts; datasets and incomplete model weights for some customers
10 Nov
Notion confirms AI chat transcripts were in the data
Under 1% of workspaces; Insights feature switched off
Uber's state breach notices go public
Thousands of US drivers per filing so far; no national total from Uber
Sources: Fireworks AI security bulletins (9 Oct, updated 9 Nov), Uber state filings as reported by ITPro and TechTimes, The Hacker News.
